messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-out shot that moves from upper-body to full-body framing. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-out shot that moves from upper-body to full-body framing. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands with her back to the camera, then raises her right arm to brush her hair back before lowering it and shifting her weight slightly.","camera":"A medium full shot from behind, with the camera slowly pulling back to reveal her full figure and casting a long shadow on the ground.","clothing":"She wears a bright pink long-sleeved cropped top, a short white pleated skirt, and black ankle boots.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair is pulled back into two low side buns.","identity":"A slim young woman with a narrow waist and long legs, seen from behind.","scene":"An outdoor stone-paved terrace or dock beside a calm blue sea under a clear sky, with a wooden post structure on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the woman from behind, beginning in an upper-body/medium framing and slowly pulling back to reveal her full body and boots. The action of raising an arm to brush her hair and then lowering it is preserved, and the clothing, hair color, and general seaside terrace environment remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a rear-view dolly-out shot starting from upper-body framing and ending in full-body framing, matching the reference for viewing direction, subject placement, and start framing while preserving the same person, hairstyle, outfit, action, timing, and environment.
uncertain: Whether the hairstyle is truly unchanged or was altered to match the rear-view reference.
Whether the environment is the exact same location or a similar generated seaside terrace.
unexpected_changes: The hairstyle appears as two low side buns from the rear, whereas the source side view showed a low bun/ponytail; the exact hairstyle may have changed due to the new angle or generation.
The background composition differs from the source, with the sea and wooden post structure arranged differently behind the subject.
